<script lang="ts">
	import { setCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { Props } from "./index.js";
	import type { CompCtxProps } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	let { item = $bindable(), defaultItem, onItemChange, shortcuts, size = "md", rounded = "lg", onsubmit, onreset, onkeydown, children, class: className, ...props }: Props = $props();
	const contextData: Omit<CompCtxProps, "activeName"> = $derived({ shortcuts: shortcuts ?? null, size, rounded, onItemChange });
	const ctx = setCompCtx({ ...contextData, activeName: item ?? defaultItem ?? "" });

	// Keep the shared settings in sync when the props change.
	$effect.pre(() => void Object.assign(ctx, contextData));

	// Keep the bindable active question and the shared state in sync in both directions.
	$effect.pre(() => void (item !== undefined && (ctx.activeName = item)));
	$effect.pre(() => void (item = ctx.activeName || undefined));

	// When the named question is missing or disabled, the first enabled one shows; report its name.
	$effect.pre(() => {
		const activeName = ctx.activeItem?.name;
		if (activeName && activeName !== ctx.activeName) ctx.activeName = activeName;
	});

	/** Blocks submitting until every question is valid, then runs the passed handler. */
	const handleSubmit = (e: SubmitEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLFormElement }) => {
		if (ctx.handleSubmit(e)) onsubmit?.(e);
	};

	/** Restores the default answers and the starting question, unless the passed handler prevented it. */
	const handleReset = (e: Event & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLFormElement }) => {
		onreset?.(e);
		// If the passed handler called preventDefault: keep everything as it is.
		if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
		// The answers live in component state, so reset them there instead of in the DOM.
		e.preventDefault();
		ctx.reset(defaultItem);
	};

	/** Runs the passed key handler, then the questionnaire keys unless it prevented them. */
	const handleKeydown = (e: KeyboardEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLFormElement }) => {
		onkeydown?.(e);
		ctx.handleKeydown(e);
	};
</script>

<!-- Form that shows one question at a time; validation is handled per question instead of by the browser. -->
<form bind:this={ctx.formEl} class={["questionnaire not-typeset", className]} novalidate data-size={size} data-rounded={rounded} data-current={ctx.progress.current} data-total={ctx.progress.total} data-first={ctx.progress.first || undefined} data-last={ctx.progress.last || undefined} data-shortcuts={shortcuts} onsubmit={handleSubmit} onreset={handleReset} onkeydown={handleKeydown} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</form>

<style>
	/* Base questionnaire; the parts read the size variables */
	.questionnaire {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: var(--questionnaire-gap);
		width: 100%;
		min-width: 0;
	}

	/* =============== Sizes =============== */

	.questionnaire[data-size="xs"] {
		--questionnaire-gap: var(--spacing-sm);
		--questionnaire-text: var(--text-xs);
		--questionnaire-title-text: var(--text-sm);
		--questionnaire-choice-min-height: var(--control-height-sm);
		--questionnaire-choice-padding-block: calc(var(--spacing-xs) * 1.5);
		--questionnaire-choice-padding-inline: var(--spacing-sm);
		--questionnaire-indicator: 0.875rem; /* 14px */
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-xs);
	}

	.questionnaire[data-size="sm"] {
		--questionnaire-gap: var(--spacing-md);
		--questionnaire-text: var(--text-sm);
		--questionnaire-title-text: var(--text-sm);
		--questionnaire-choice-min-height: var(--control-height-lg);
		--questionnaire-choice-padding-block: var(--spacing-sm);
		--questionnaire-choice-padding-inline: calc(var(--spacing-sm) + var(--spacing-xs) / 2);
		--questionnaire-indicator: 1rem; /* 16px */
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-sm);
	}

	/* Medium matches the shadcn questionnaire: 44px choices with 10px by 12px padding */
	.questionnaire[data-size="md"] {
		--questionnaire-gap: var(--spacing-lg);
		--questionnaire-text: var(--text-sm);
		--questionnaire-title-text: var(--text-md);
		--questionnaire-choice-min-height: 2.75rem; /* 44px */
		--questionnaire-choice-padding-block: calc(var(--spacing-sm) + var(--spacing-xs) / 2);
		--questionnaire-choice-padding-inline: var(--spacing-md);
		--questionnaire-indicator: 1rem; /* 16px */
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-md);
	}

	.questionnaire[data-size="lg"] {
		--questionnaire-gap: var(--spacing-xl);
		--questionnaire-text: var(--text-md);
		--questionnaire-title-text: calc(var(--text-md) * 1.125);
		--questionnaire-choice-min-height: 3rem; /* 48px */
		--questionnaire-choice-padding-block: var(--spacing-md);
		--questionnaire-choice-padding-inline: var(--spacing-lg);
		--questionnaire-indicator: 1.125rem; /* 18px */
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-lg);
	}

	/* =============== Rounded =============== */

	/* Overrides the size radius of the choices and inputs; must stay after the size rules */
	.questionnaire[data-rounded="xs"] {
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-xs);
	}

	.questionnaire[data-rounded="sm"] {
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-sm);
	}

	.questionnaire[data-rounded="md"] {
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-md);
	}

	.questionnaire[data-rounded="lg"] {
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-lg);
	}

	.questionnaire[data-rounded="xl"] {
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-xl);
	}

	.questionnaire[data-rounded="2xl"] {
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-2xl);
	}

	.questionnaire[data-rounded="3xl"] {
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-3xl);
	}

	.questionnaire[data-rounded="4xl"] {
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-4xl);
	}

	/* A true pill; tall content can clip at the corners, so use 3xl or 4xl to stay safe */
	.questionnaire[data-rounded="pill"] {
		--questionnaire-radius: var(--radius-pill);
	}
</style>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { onDestroy, untrack } from "svelte";
	import { Input } from "#lib/components/ui/input/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx, useItemCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { InputProps } from "./index.js";
	let { value = $bindable(), defaultValue = "", type = "text", disabled = false, oninput, class: className, ...props }: InputProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const item = useItemCtx();
	const id = $props.id();
	// Typed text; starts from the bound value or the default.
	let text = $state(value ?? defaultValue);
	const isDisabled = $derived(disabled || item.disabled);
	const isFilled = $derived(text.trim().length > 0);
	const isSelected = $derived(item.selectedIds.includes(id));
	// Register while rendering, so a starting answer is known before the first paint.
	const unregister = item.registerAnswer(
		{
			id,
			kind: "input",
			get disabled() {
				return isDisabled;
			},
			reset: () => (text = defaultValue),
		},
		text.trim().length > 0,
	);

	// Keep the bindable value and the typed text in sync in both directions.
	$effect.pre(() => void (value !== undefined && (text = value)));
	$effect.pre(() => void (value = text));

	// Text set from outside, such as a reset or a bound value, picks or clears the answer.
	$effect.pre(() => {
		const filled = isFilled;
		untrack(() => item.select(id, filled));
	});

	// Leave the question when the input unmounts.
	onDestroy(unregister);

	/** Picks the typed answer once it has text, and clears it when emptied. */
	const handleInput = (e: Event & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLInputElement }) => {
		oninput?.(e);
		item.select(id, e.currentTarget.value.trim().length > 0);
	};
</script>

<!-- Free-text answer; submitted under the question's name only while it is the picked answer. -->
<Input {id} {type} class={["questionnaireInput", className]} size={ctx.size} rounded={ctx.rounded} name={isSelected && !item.skipped ? item.name : undefined} disabled={isDisabled} aria-invalid={item.isInvalid || undefined} aria-keyshortcuts={!isDisabled && isFilled ? "Enter" : undefined} data-filled={isFilled || undefined} data-empty={!isFilled || undefined} bind:value={text} oninput={handleInput} {...props} />

<style>
	/* Fills the question's width, like the choices */
	:global(.questionnaireInput) {
		width: 100%;
	}
</style>
{#if children} {@render children()} {:else} {item.required ? "Choose an answer to continue." : "Choose an answer or skip this question."} {/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import { onDestroy } from "svelte";
	import { setItemCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { ItemProps } from "./index.js";
	import type { ItemCtxProps } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	const { name, required = false, multiple = false, disabled = false, invalid = false, onStatusChange, "aria-describedby": ariaDescribedBy, children, class: className, ...props }: ItemProps = $props();
	const baseId = $props.id();
	const contextData: ItemCtxProps = $derived({ name, required, multiple, disabled, invalidProp: invalid, baseId });
	const item = setItemCtx({ ...contextData });
	// Register while rendering, so the server already knows the question order.
	const unregister = item.root?.registerItem(item);
	const describedBy = $derived([...item.descriptionIds, ...(item.isInvalid ? item.errorIds : []), ariaDescribedBy].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || undefined);
	// Keys announced to assistive technology while the question is active.
	const keyShortcuts = $derived.by(() => {
		if (!item.isActive) return undefined;
		const progress = item.root?.progress;
		const keys = ["Meta+Enter Control+Enter", item.enabledAnswers.length ? "ArrowUp ArrowDown" : "", progress?.first ? "" : "ArrowLeft", !progress?.last && item.status !== "unanswered" ? "ArrowRight" : ""];
		return keys.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
	});
	// Status reported last, so the callback only runs on a change.
	let previousStatus = item.status;

	// Keep the shared settings in sync when the props change.
	$effect.pre(() => void Object.assign(item, contextData));

	// Leave the questionnaire when the question unmounts.
	onDestroy(() => unregister?.());

	// Report when the question becomes answered, unanswered, or skipped.
	$effect(() => {
		const status = item.status;
		if (status === previousStatus) return;
		previousStatus = status;
		onStatusChange?.(status);
	});
</script>

<!-- One question; hidden and inert until it is the active one. -->
<fieldset bind:this={item.element} class={["questionnaireItem", className]} tabindex="-1" hidden={!item.isActive} inert={!item.isActive} {disabled} aria-describedby={describedBy} aria-keyshortcuts={keyShortcuts} data-active={item.isActive || undefined} data-status={item.status} data-required={required || undefined} data-multiple={multiple || undefined} data-disabled={disabled || undefined} data-invalid={item.isInvalid || undefined} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</fieldset>

<style>
	/* Base question; resets the native fieldset frame */
	.questionnaireItem {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: var(--questionnaire-gap);
		margin: 0;
		outline: none;
		border: 0;
		padding: 0;
		min-width: 0;
	}

	/* The flex display would otherwise override the hidden attribute */
	.questionnaireItem[hidden] {
		display: none;
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { ActionProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, variant = "default", size, rounded, disabled = false, onclick, class: className, ...props }: ActionProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const isVisible = $derived(ctx.progress.total > 1 && !ctx.progress.last);

	/** Checks the active question and goes forward, unless the passed handler prevented it. */
	const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLButtonElement }) => {
		onclick?.(e);
		if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.goNext();
	};
</script>

<!-- Checks the answer and goes forward; hidden on the last question. -->
{#if isVisible}
	<Button type="button" {variant} size={size ?? ctx.size} rounded={rounded ?? ctx.rounded} {disabled} class={["questionnaireAction", className]} data-questionnaire-action="next" aria-keyshortcuts={disabled ? undefined : "Enter"} onclick={handleClick} {...props}>
		{#if children}
			{@render children()}
		{:else}
			Next
		{/if}
	</Button>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { ActionProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, variant = "outline", size, rounded, disabled = false, onclick, class: className, ...props }: ActionProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const isVisible = $derived(ctx.progress.total > 1 && !ctx.progress.first);

	/** Goes back one question, unless the passed handler prevented it. */
	const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLButtonElement }) => {
		onclick?.(e);
		if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.goPrevious();
	};
</script>

<!-- Goes back one question; hidden on the first question. -->
{#if isVisible}
	<Button type="button" {variant} size={size ?? ctx.size} rounded={rounded ?? ctx.rounded} {disabled} class={["questionnaireAction", className]} data-questionnaire-action="previous" onclick={handleClick} {...props}>
		{#if children}
			{@render children()}
		{:else}
			Previous
		{/if}
	</Button>
{/if}
{#if children} {@render children(ctx.progress)} {:else} {label} {/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { ActionProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, variant = "outline", size, rounded, disabled = false, onclick, class: className, ...props }: ActionProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const isVisible = $derived(ctx.activeItem !== undefined && !ctx.activeItem.required);

	/** Skips the active question, unless the passed handler prevented it. */
	const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLButtonElement }) => {
		onclick?.(e);
		if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.skipCurrent();
	};
</script>

<!-- Skips the active question; shown only for optional questions. -->
{#if isVisible}
	<Button type="button" {variant} size={size ?? ctx.size} rounded={rounded ?? ctx.rounded} {disabled} class={["questionnaireAction", className]} data-questionnaire-action="skip" onclick={handleClick} {...props}>
		{#if children}
			{@render children()}
		{:else}
			Skip
		{/if}
	</Button>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { ActionProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, variant = "default", size, rounded, disabled = false, class: className, ...props }: ActionProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const isVisible = $derived(ctx.progress.total > 0 && ctx.progress.last);
</script>

<!-- Submits the form; shown only on the last question. -->
{#if isVisible}
	<Button type="submit" {variant} size={size ?? ctx.size} rounded={rounded ?? ctx.rounded} {disabled} class={["questionnaireAction", className]} data-questionnaire-action="submit" aria-keyshortcuts={disabled ? undefined : "Enter"} {...props}>
		{#if children}
			{@render children()}
		{:else}
			Submit
		{/if}
	</Button>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { TitleProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: TitleProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Question text as the fieldset legend. -->
<legend class={["questionnaireTitle", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</legend>

<style>
	/* The legend sits outside the fieldset's flex layout, so it spaces itself with padding */
	.questionnaireTitle {
		padding: 0;
		width: 100%;
		font-weight: 500;
		font-size: var(--questionnaire-title-text);
		line-height: 1.375;
		text-wrap: pretty;
	}

	/* Without a description, the gap comes from the title */
	.questionnaireTitle:not(:has(~ :global(.questionnaireDescription))) {
		padding-bottom: var(--questionnaire-gap);
	}
</style>
